name: Ghoul Rib
summary: Ghoul Ribs are harvested from the undead prowling the haunted groves and cemeteries of Duskwood. The hermit Abercrombie claims to need them as materials to construct a grotesque effigy to ward off the flesh-eating horrors near his shack.

sections.title: A Gruesome Ward
sections.body: The cursed forest of Duskwood crawls with violent undead, including ravenous ghouls such as Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. Abercrombie, an eccentric recluse living isolated on the bluffs of Beggar's Haunt, requests these sturdy, rotted bones from passing travelers. He claims that living outside the protection of the Night Watch in Darkshire leaves him vulnerable, and that assembling a terrifying effigy from ghoul ribs will serve as a scarecrow to frighten off prowling packs of the dead.

sections.title: Suspicions Around the Shack
sections.body: While gathering parts of slain undead is common enough for survival in hostile regions, Abercrombie's specific fascination with ghoul anatomy raises eyebrows. Rather than seeking sanctuary behind Darkshire's palisades or relying on consecrated wards, the hermit insists on gathering raw necromantic offal to fortify his secluded home.

faq.answer: They can be harvested from various types of ghouls across Duskwood, including Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones, and Plague Spreaders. These monsters haunt old graveyards, roadside ruins, and abandoned homesteads throughout the forest.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want these bones?
aliases: what does abercrombie do with ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims he lives too far from Darkshire to rely on the Night Watch for protection. He asks for the ribs to construct a crude scarecrow or effigy to deter roving undead from pounding on his walls.

faq.q: Do scarecrows actually keep ghouls away?
faq.answer: Undead generally lack fear and are driven entirely by mindless hunger or dark necromantic compulsion. The idea that mindless ghouls would flee from a scarecrow made of bones is unusual, yet Abercrombie insists it will keep his home safe.

aliases: where to turn in ghoul ribs
faq.answer: Abercrombie lives in a ramshackle shack on the northern plateau known as Beggar's Haunt, situated northeast of Darkshire and east of Manor Mistmantle.

angles.text: Handling the desecrated bones of the restless dead is distasteful work, but assisting an isolated hermit against ravenous monstrosities aligns with guarding the living from Duskwood's horrors.
The twisted reanimation binding these bones reflects the deep shadow that has fallen over Duskwood, turning fallen villagers into ravenous scavengers.
